issues.description: Ingest commits valid records before rejecting files whose malformed-row ratio exceeds 10%, leaving partial data after a failed command.
upsert_jobs commits internally, preventing callers from composing parse/validate/write as a single atomic transaction.
Rows with missing columns can raise AttributeError/TypeError instead of RowParseError, crashing ingest instead of counting the row as malformed.
Rows with extra pipe-delimited columns are silently accepted because DictReader extras under the None key are never checked.
Timestamp parsing validates but preserves mixed formats/timezones, making downstream text comparisons unreliable.
Reports and newest-record selection rely on lexicographic TEXT timestamp comparisons, which can produce incorrect windows for non-canonical timestamps.
Failure reporting hard-codes only FAILED, TIMEOUT, and OOM, so other non-success states are omitted from failure reports and rates.
Report commands silently create a new empty SQLite database when the requested database path is wrong or missing.
Malformed-threshold coverage checks the exit code but not that the failed ingest leaves the database unchanged.
Project has no configured linting, formatting, typing, or coverage gates for the cleanup-to-active-development stage.
